YUMC.US.evidence: Issuer closing release: Pizza Hut Mainland China brand ownership acquired for US$1.2 billion. To fund it the company secured an offshore RMB bridge loan equivalent to approximately US$1.2 billion, up to 12 months, interest around 2%.
YUMC.US.assumption: Approximate closing pro-forma: USD 1.2bn loan funds USD 1.2bn purchase, so cash is unchanged and debt increases USD 1.2bn. Charge USD 24m annual pretax interest with no tax benefit, licence-fee savings or synergies credited. Actual FX, fees and purchase-price allocation are unreported here; this is not a subsequently filed balance sheet. Reconcile at the next interim.
